info.name: Service 7 - Vulnerability Management (Elias Ghanem)
info.description: Postman requests for the six Vulnerability Management APIs, implemented by Elias Ghanem. Run the users (5001), assets (5002) and vulnerabilities (5007) services, fill in the username/password collection variables for one active account per role (ADMIN, ANALYST, AUDITOR, EMPLOYEE), then run the folders in order. The setup folder logs in and creates two assets; tokens and IDs are saved automatically in collection variables.

request.description: Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in the adminToken collection variable.
Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in the analystToken collection variable.
Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in the auditorToken collection variable.
Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in the employeeToken collection variable.
Assets service (setup only): every vulnerability must reference an existing affected asset.
Assets service (setup only): every vulnerability must reference an existing affected asset.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Add New Vulnerability (XZ Utils, Critical)

request.description: Admin creates a vulnerability. Status always starts as Open; severity must match the CVSS v3.x rating of the score.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "XZ Utils backdoor",
  "description": "Malicious code in liblzma 5.6.0/5.6.1 allows remote access through sshd.",
  "cve_identifier": "CVE-2024-3094",
  "cvss_score": 10.0,
  "severity": "Critical",
  "affected_asset_id": {{assetId}},
  "discovery_source": "Vulnerability Scan"
}

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Duplicate CVE on same asset (409)

request.description: A CVE can only be tracked once per asset until that record is Closed.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Severity does not match CVSS score (400)

request.description: CVSS 8.1 is rated High, so severity Medium is rejected with a validation error.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "OpenSSH regreSSHion",
  "description": "Signal handler race in sshd.",
  "cve_identifier": "CVE-2024-6387",
  "cvss_score": 8.1,
  "severity": "Medium",
  "affected_asset_id": {{assetId}},
  "discovery_source": "Vulnerability Scan"
}

request.description: cve_identifier must have the format CVE-YYYY-NNNN.
Every required field is listed in the error message.
Each vulnerability must be associated with one existing asset.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Analyst cannot create (403)

request.description: Only the Security Administrator can add vulnerabilities.
Every vulnerability endpoint requires a Bearer token.
Newest first; each record includes severity, status and affected asset details.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Retrieve All Vulnerabilities (Auditor, read-only)

request.description: Auditors have read-only access.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Employee cannot list (403)

request.description: Regular employees have no access to vulnerability APIs.
Returns the complete vulnerability record.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Retrieve invalid vulnerability ID (404)

request.description: Unknown IDs return a JSON 404 error.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Update description, CVSS and severity (Analyst)

request.description: Analysts may update description, severity, status, cvss_score and resolution_date.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Status Open -> Under Investigation (Analyst)

request.description: Status advances exactly one lifecycle stage.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Status Under Investigation -> In Progress (Analyst)
Elias Ghanem - Status In Progress -> Resolved (Analyst)

request.description: The resolution date is recorded automatically when no resolution_date is supplied.
Closed is the final, read-only stage.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Modify a closed vulnerability (409)

request.description: Closed records cannot be modified.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Invalid transition Open -> Closed (409)

request.description: Skipping lifecycle stages is rejected; the error names the next allowed status.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - CVSS change without matching severity (400)

request.description: CVSS 5.0 is Medium but the record is Critical, so severity must be updated too.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Resolution date on an unresolved vulnerability (409)

request.description: resolution_date can only be set when the status is Resolved or Closed.
Title, CVE, affected asset and discovery source cannot be changed.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Auditor cannot update (403)

request.description: Auditors are read-only.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Search by CVE identifier (partial)

request.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the CVE identifier.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Search with combined filters

request.description: Filters are combined with AND.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Search with no results

request.description: Returns 200 with an empty list.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Employee cannot search (403)
Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Analyst cannot delete (403)

request.description: Only administrators may delete vulnerability records.
